repos.description: Development at the speed of light
repos.summary_zh: SpacetimeDB 是一个基于 Rust 构建的分布式数据库系统，专为实时应用设计，支持边缘计算与区块链集成。它通过去中心化架构实现毫秒级数据同步，适用于游戏、物联网和去中心化应用，提供高可用性与强一致性。
repos.summary_en: SpacetimeDB is a distributed database system built in Rust, designed for real-time applications with edge computing and blockchain integration. It enables millisecond-scale data synchronization via a decentralized architecture, ideal for gaming, IoT, and decentralized apps, offering high availability and strong consistency.

repos.summary_zh: 该项目曾用于将微信读书的划线和笔记自动同步至Notion，通过GitHub Action定时执行实现数据迁移。现已因接口限制失效，官方推荐使用Chrome插件替代。项目提供微信群、QQ群支持及捐赠渠道，作者持续维护多个类似自动化工具。
repos.summary_en: This project previously automated syncing WeChat Read highlights and notes to Notion via GitHub Actions. It is now deprecated due to API limitations, with a Chrome extension recommended as the current solution. The author maintains related automation tools and offers community support through WeChat/QQ groups.

repos.description: 📝 一个一键导出 / 备份「有道云笔记」所有笔记的 Python 脚本。 A Python script to export/backup all the notes of the "Youdao Note".
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本实现有道云笔记一键导出与备份，支持将笔记按原格式下载至本地并自动转换为 Markdown 格式。内置图床图片本地化或上传 SM.MS 功能，完全本地运行保障数据安全，提供可视化配置文件和视频教程，适合非技术人员使用。
repos.summary_en: This script enables one-click export and backup of all notes from Youdao Note, downloading files locally in original format and converting them to Markdown. It supports local image hosting or uploading to SM.MS, runs entirely offline for security, and includes user-friendly config files and video guides for non-technical users.

repos.description: 微信聊天记录导出、分析工具
repos.summary_zh: Wechat Explorer 是一款专为 iOS 设备设计的微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，通过解析 iTunes 备份中的微信数据，支持导出聊天室记录、统计好友标签及聊天室活跃度，并可生成 HTML 报告转为 PDF，适用于个人数据备份与社交行为分析。
repos.summary_en: Wechat Explorer is an iOS-focused tool for exporting and analyzing WeChat chat records by parsing iTunes backups. It supports exporting chatroom logs, generating friend label statistics, and creating PDF reports from HTML exports, ideal for personal data archiving and social behavior insights.

repos.description: :zap: Sync all of your VSCode settings across multiple devices, supports any VSCode variant.
repos.summary_zh: VSCode Syncing 是一款强大的 VSCode 扩展，支持跨设备同步用户设置、键位绑定、扩展、语言包和代码片段至 GitHub Gist。支持增量同步、自动安装扩展、代理配置，并兼容 VSCodium、Cursor 等 VSCode 衍生版本。
repos.summary_en: VSCode Syncing is a powerful extension that synchronizes all VSCode settings—including user settings, keybindings, extensions, snippets, and locales—across multiple devices via GitHub Gist. It supports incremental sync, automatic extension management, proxy configuration, and works with any VSCode variant like VSCodium and Cursor.

repos.description: 😃 md 编辑器使用的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步到多个内容平台。
repos.summary_zh: COSE 是一款专为 Markdown 编辑器设计的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步至 30+ 主流内容平台。核心亮点包括跨平台同步、自动登录检测、标签页分组管理，尤其针对微信公众号提供样式保留与草稿自动保存功能，全程本地运行保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: COSE is a browser extension designed for Markdown editors, enabling one-click article publishing to 30+ platforms. Key features include cross-platform sync, auto-login detection, tab grouping, and full CSS preservation for WeChat Official Accounts. Runs entirely locally with zero data collection.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的轻量级两步验证密钥管理系统，支持 TOTP/HOTP 生成、多方式添加密钥（扫码/图片识别/拖拽/粘贴）、AES-256-GCM 加密存储，兼容主流应用批量导入导出，具备 WebDAV/S3 远程同步、自动备份还原及响应式设计，实现免费全球部署与离线 PWA 使用。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight two-factor authentication (2FA) key management system built on Cloudflare Workers, supporting TOTP/HOTP generation, multi-method key addition (QR scan/image recognition/drag-and-drop/paste), AES-256-GCM encryption, batch import/export from major apps, WebDAV/S3 sync, auto backup/restore, and responsive design for offline PWA use with global free deployment.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目通过 GitHub Actions 实现豆瓣电影和读书数据的自动化同步至 Notion，支持每日定时抓取与更新。提供网页预览效果，集成微信公众号教程与用户交流群，具备完善的社区支持和持续迭代计划。
repos.summary_en: This project automates daily synchronization of Douban movies and books to Notion via GitHub Actions, featuring web previews, WeChat-based tutorials, user communities, and ongoing updates with donation support.

repos.summary_zh: Hexo七牛同步插件是一个专为Hexo博客设计的自动化工具，支持将本地静态资源（图片、JS、CSS）自动同步至七牛云存储，无需手动上传。通过配置实现一键部署，支持图片处理、缩略图生成及离线预览，提升博客资源管理效率。
repos.summary_en: Hexo Qiniu Sync is an automation plugin for Hexo blogs that synchronizes local static assets (images, JS, CSS) to Qiniu Cloud Storage. It enables one-click deployment with image processing, thumbnail generation, and offline preview support, streamlining resource management.

repos.description: 同步豆瓣标记条目到 Notion/NeoDB
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库实现豆瓣标记数据（看过/听过/读过）通过RSS订阅同步至Notion数据库和NeoDB平台，支持自动抓取条目详情、评分、短评等信息，并通过GitHub Actions定时执行，适合个人知识管理。
repos.summary_en: This repository enables syncing Douban marked entries (watched/listened/read) to Notion databases and NeoDB via RSS, automatically fetching details like ratings and reviews using GitHub Actions for scheduled updates.

repos.description: 🛡✍️ Keeps your Notion workspace safe and version controlled at all times.
repos.summary_zh: Notion Guardian 是一款自动化工具，通过 GitHub Actions 每日备份 Notion 工作区并提交到私有仓库，实现数据版本控制与安全存储。支持完整导出工作区内容，分离脚本与数据，确保备份纯净。适用于需要长期追踪笔记变更、保障数据安全的企业或个人用户。
repos.summary_en: Notion Guardian is an automation tool that uses GitHub Actions to daily back up your Notion workspace and commit changes to a private repository, enabling version control and data security. It exports the entire workspace cleanly, separating scripts from data for pure backups. Ideal for users needing long-term note tracking and secure storage.

repos.description: 【abcd修改版-个人用】托管在cloudflare上的轻量化导航，可以同步谷歌书签
repos.summary_zh: CloudNav-abcd 是基于 Cloudflare Pages 的免费个人导航站，支持谷歌书签同步、AI智能分类与简介生成、WebDAV双重备份及密码保护。提供拖拽排序、右键快捷操作、Chrome扩展插件等高效功能，适配多端访问，适合个人知识管理。
repos.summary_en: CloudNav-abcd is a free personal navigation site hosted on Cloudflare Pages, supporting Google bookmark sync, AI-powered auto-categorization and descriptions, WebDAV dual backup, and password protection. Features drag-and-drop sorting, right-click shortcuts, Chrome extension, and cross-device access for efficient knowledge management.

repos.description: 🚀 New API 智能价格同步工具 - 解决自定义模型前缀导致的价格同步失效问题。智能推断上游基础价，一键同步模型价格。
repos.summary_zh: PriceSyncPro 是一款专为 New API 设计的浏览器插件，解决自定义模型前缀导致的价格同步失效问题。通过智能推断上游基础价、自动适配 New API 和 One Hub 数据源，支持一键创建渠道/供货商/模型配置或批量更新价格，全程无需手动 SQL 操作，显著提升价格管理效率。
repos.summary_en: PriceSyncPro is a browser plugin designed for New API to resolve price sync failures caused by custom model prefixes. It intelligently infers upstream base prices, auto-adapts to New API and One Hub data sources, enabling one-click channel/supplier/model setup or bulk price updates without manual SQL operations, significantly streamlining price management.

repos.description: A Flask-based tool that types or copies text from mobile devices directly to Windows computers.
repos.summary_zh: EasyType 是一款基于 Flask 的跨平台输入工具，支持手机实时输入内容并直接推送到 Windows 剪贴板或模拟键盘输入，具备低延迟同步、移动端优化界面和多种快捷键支持，适用于远程办公与高效输入场景。
repos.summary_en: EasyType is a Flask-based tool enabling real-time text input from mobile devices to Windows via clipboard or direct keyboard simulation, featuring low-latency sync, mobile-optimized UI, and shortcut support for remote typing and clipboard sharing.

repos.summary_zh: 该工具使用 Golang 开发，实现微信读书笔记、划线等内容的自动化同步至 Notion 数据库。支持 GitHub Actions、Docker 及 docker-compose 部署，提供定时任务能力，适用于个人知识管理与阅读笔记归档场景。
repos.summary_en: A Golang-based tool that automates syncing WeRead notes and highlights to a Notion database. Supports deployment via GitHub Actions, Docker, or docker-compose with scheduled execution, ideal for personal knowledge management and reading note archiving.

repos.description: hexo插件 - 七牛资源同步. 可以在本地存放好静态资源（图片、JS、CSS），然后在md文章中直接使用标签引用，在发布时会自动将静态资源上传到你的七牛空间中，并在hexo生成的静态页面中自动引用这些静态资源在千牛的url。
repos.summary_zh: hexo-qiniu-sync 是一个 Hexo 插件，用于自动将本地静态资源（如图片、JS、CSS）同步至七牛云存储，并在生成的静态页面中自动替换为七牛外链 URL。支持离线预览、增量同步、图片处理（缩略图/水印）等功能，简化博客资源管理流程。
repos.summary_en: hexo-qiniu-sync is a Hexo plugin that automatically syncs local static resources (images, JS, CSS) to Qiniu Cloud Storage and replaces references in generated pages with Qiniu CDN URLs. It supports offline preview, incremental sync, image processing (thumbnails/watermarks), and simplifies blog asset management.
